---
kind: chapter
n: 3
title: The Lamp
---

SCENE: The harbour wall, night
The wind has dropped. The beam is dark for the first time in years.
ON SCREEN: Mara (holding a lantern), Tomas (holding the bottle)
TOMAS (scared): The lamp is out.
MARA: Then we light it.
---
SCENE: The lighthouse kitchen, dawn
Pale light on the stove. Two cups of tea steam on the table.
ON SCREEN: Mara (smiling), Tomas (grinning)
MARA (happy): The lamp is lit and the boats are home.
TOMAS: Best late arrival ever.
